arrangement.notes: Arrangement features sample-based layering with texture beds and prominent one-shot hits creating a hook-heavy, uplifting feel with experimental variations in groove and atmosphere.

event_markers.label: Hook Start
event_markers.reason: High energy hook emphasis with hook-heavy rhythm pattern

event_markers.label: Bridge FX buildup
event_markers.reason: Prepare for bridge section with atmospheric texture layers

event_markers.label: Final Hook Start
event_markers.reason: Crescendo and climax of melody with hook prominence

sound_intent.texture_bed: Create a warm, immersive ambient background to fill space and support groove
sound_intent.one_shot_hits: Use chopped and sliced percussion samples emphasizing hook parts
sound_intent.dynamic_variation: Experimental modulation on sample playback speeds and filter envelopes

routing_intent.drums: Send to parallel compression and transient shaping for punch and clarity
routing_intent.bass: Apply sidechain compression keyed to drums to create rhythmic pumping
routing_intent.chords: Light reverb and delay effects to add space and depth
routing_intent.melody: Automated filters and subtle distortion on hook sections
routing_intent.vocal: Clean preamp + delay with low feedback on verses
routing_intent.fx: LFO modulated effects pads and risers for transitions

track_roles.drums: Rhythmic foundation using sample-based chopped and sliced percussion layers
track_roles.bass: Low-end groove supporting rhythm and harmony
track_roles.chords: Harmonic support created from sampled layers and texture beds
track_roles.melody: Lead melodic statement, mainly in hook sections emphasizing uplifting feel
track_roles.vocal: Rap and vocal phrasing embedded rhythmically within verses and hooks

designer_intent.style: West Coast Experimental Hip-Hop with uplifting vibe and hook focus
designer_intent.sample_technique: Use of sample slicing, chopping, and texture beds to build arrangement

presetor_intent.effects: Presets should complement experimental textures, maintain clarity on samples, and emphasize hook energy

sensei_drum.brief: Generate drum patterns with chopped, sliced, and glitchy one-shot hits focusing on hook-heavy energy profile.

bass_generator.brief: Create grooving bass lines supporting drums with sample-based sounds, ensuring fullness in low-end.

harmony_generator.brief: Arrange chord samples and texture beds to sustain uplifting mood and fill harmonic space.

melody_generator.brief: Produce melodic layers emphasizing hooks with variation on playback textures and harmonics.

ai_designer.brief: Oversee arrangement flow, ensure experimental variations and energy curve balance for uplifting feel.

presetor.brief: Select and tweak sound presets to bring out texture bed ambiance and crisp one-shot hit character.

songgps.brief: Map arrangement sections and transitions accurately with energy markers and phase changes.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Maintain clarity and punch through parallel compression and sidechain routing in final mix.
